concerns.text: Tasks T036, T036a, T036b, and T036c are marked [X] (completed) in the task list, yet the Analyze Report and Plan.md explicitly state these artifacts (Decision Records and updated spec) are missing/rejected. This creates a coverage gap where the 'completed' tasks cannot satisfy the Spec/Plan requirement to document deviations, as the required artifacts do not exist.

Task T006 includes a fallback architecture ('ResNet based VQ-VAE') and unresolved claim [UNRESOLVED-CLAIM: c_fdb86f4e] not present in Spec.md or Plan.md. The Spec mandates a 'ViQ' model; the task introduces an unverified alternative without a corresponding FR/SC or Plan element to cover, creating an implementation ambiguity.

Task T014 requires asserting {{claim:c_ea18f858}} as a success condition. No such claim or metric threshold is defined in Spec.md (which only requires calculating PSNR/SSIM) or Plan.md. The task cannot be verified against the current spec/plan elements.

Task T019b ('HYPOTHESIS VALIDATION ON REMAINING DATASETS') has no matching FR/SC or Plan element. The Spec (FR-003) and Plan explicitly exclude ChestX-ray14 and define evaluation on ImageNet+COCO. This task duplicates the scope of US-2/FR-002 without a unique requirement to cover, indicating a scope creep or orphan task.

Tasks T038 ('high-frequency energy' metric) and T039 ('dynamic threshold calculation') introduce new metrics and artifacts not requested by any FR/SC in Spec.md. The Spec defines SC-001 (Laplacian Variance) and SC-004 (paired t-test/Wilcoxon) but does not mandate these specific new metrics, leaving these tasks without a spec requirement to cover.

Task T036c requires updating spec.md to remove ChestX-ray14 from US-2. However, the provided spec.md already contains the exclusion note in US-2 ('Note: This story is restricted to natural images...'). The task description implies the spec is still non-compliant, creating a stale tag/requirement mismatch.
